item.title: High-Bay Warehouse with Long Rack Dwell Time
item.description:
For a high-bay warehouse storing boxed goods, the main risk was long-term deflection across a defined beam span. A reinforced solid three-runner platform was shortlisted for its continuous deck and expanded tube options.

The confirmation plan included load-distribution drawings, steel layout, maximum dwell time and a sample rack test. Conveyor transitions and sensor targets were checked before the pallet specification was frozen.

item.title: Ventilated Pallet for Automated Cold Storage
item.description:
A grid three-runner pallet was considered for a cold-storage flow requiring drainage, visual inspection and four-way forklift access. The project review focused on low-temperature material behavior, rack span and anti-slip requirements.

A representative sample was conditioned to the operating temperature and tested across rack and conveyor interfaces before approval.

item.title: Full-Perimeter Base on a Mixed Conveyor Line
item.description:
A mixed conveyor line used rollers, chains and mechanical stops. The full-perimeter base offered a broader contact pattern, but runner positions and transfer clearances still required drawing review.

The team mapped every transition, confirmed entry direction and ran a loaded sample through the critical points before production.
